levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عمر

notes: the two «ح» branches write their own names, so they are separate groups with a null tail; the first branch ends at حماد as written and is not extended
«قال أبو كامل ابن الزبير» names a different transmitter for the level of محمد بن جعفر: a variant remark, not a route
«- يعني ابن زريع -» is an editor gloss on يزيد, left out
«أبيه» is Abdullah b. Umar, a relation with no name in this text
